NOTE: A document known as "A Uniform Traffic Ordinance" has been drafted for the state of Georgia to fill in certain gaps in municipal traffic regulations left by the Uniform Rules of the Road. A bill incorporating this document has been submitted to the state legislature and will,.if enacted at the next legislative session, authorize municipalities and counties to adopt by reference this complement to the Uniform Rules’ of the Road.
